text: This report requests the Board's endorsement of actions taken with respect to the Concierge Services contract, which were necessary due to the cancellation of the Board meeting of September 20, 2018.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Concurred with the action taken by the Chair of the Board and the Chief Executive Officer in approving the award of contract with BBW International Inc. to provide concierge services on the terms and conditions set out in the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer and City Solicitor.
